documents.population: International applicants to undergraduate and postgraduate coursework degrees
documents.notes: Adelaide University 'Apply now - international students'. Applicants from the Middle East, North Africa, Sub-Saharan Africa, South Asia, the Philippines and Latin America must apply through an authorised Education Agent. Not drafted: professional qualifications or memberships, syllabus of subjects for advanced standing (credit transfer), the AUD 150 application fee.

items.quote: All international applications to study an undergraduate or postgraduate coursework degree at Adelaide University are submitted online through our Online Application System .
You'll need to provide certified copies of your official academic documents as part of your application. This includes academic transcripts and graduation certificates for all secondary school
Certified copies of your academic transcripts and graduate certificates (if applicable) for all secondary school and tertiary studies
items.condition: if applicable (a graduation certificate has been issued)

items.quote: If your official documents are in a language other than English, you will also need to provide certified translations of these documents, in addition to certified copies of the original non-English documents.
items.condition: official documents in a language other than English

items.quote: Official English test results from IELTS, TOEFL iBT, Pearson or Cambridge CAE/CPE or another approved objective test
items.condition: English requirement not met through previous academic qualifications or professional use of English ('You may also need to provide')
